intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryStreamService without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. @Service, open-host read side. Constructor(TelemetryEventBus). windows returns only TelemetryWindowBuffered events from the bus; outcomes returns TelemetrySampleValidated/ValidationFailed events. Both are hot, backpressure-aware Fluxes exposing no reorder-window internals.
